name: cubeduel

scripts.prebuild: npm run tables:build && npm run demo:build
scripts.e2e: python3 e2e/a11y.py && python3 e2e/timer.py && python3 e2e/play.py && python3 e2e/train.py && python3 e2e/goal.py && python3 e2e/mobile.py && python3 e2e/ranked.py && python3 e2e/duel.py && python3 e2e/challenge.py && python3 e2e/rush.py && python3 e2e/auth.py && python3 e2e/recovery.py && python3 e2e/cube.py && python3 e2e/clubs.py && python3 e2e/solve.py && python3 e2e/learn.py && python3 e2e/cubelink.py && python3 e2e/keymap.py && python3 e2e/howto.py && python3 e2e/looking.py && python3 e2e/cstimer.py && python3 e2e/race.py && python3 e2e/cards.py && python3 e2e/review.py && python3 e2e/home.py && python3 e2e/solver.py && python3 e2e/lessons.py && python3 e2e/vitals.py && python3 e2e/puzzles.py && python3 e2e/offline.py && python3 e2e/milestones.py && python3 e2e/follow.py && python3 e2e/weekly.py
scripts.integration:local: node scripts/db-local.mjs up && node scripts/db-local.mjs run -- node scripts/integration-all.mjs
scripts.integration: node scripts/db-local.mjs run -- node scripts/integration-all.mjs integration-ranked.mts
scripts.integration:challenges: node scripts/db-local.mjs run -- node scripts/integration-all.mjs integration-challenges.mts
scripts.integration:rush: node scripts/db-local.mjs run -- node scripts/integration-all.mjs integration-rush.mts
scripts.integration:passkeys: node scripts/db-local.mjs run -- node scripts/integration-all.mjs integration-passkeys.mts
scripts.e2e:https: NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL=https://localhost:3443 npm run build && (NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL=https://localhost:3443 npm run start & node scripts/tls-dev.mjs &) && sleep 10 && python3 e2e/https.py; code=$?; lsof -ti:3000,3443 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; exit $code
scripts.e2e:local: npm run db:up && npm run build && node scripts/db-local.mjs run -- sh -c 'lsof -ti:3000 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; (npx next start -p 3000 > .next/e2e-server.log 2>&1 &); sleep 8; DEV_LOG=.next/e2e-server.log BASE=http://localhost:3000 npm run e2e; code=$?; lsof -ti:3000 | xargs kill -9 2>/dev/null; exit $code'
scripts.integration:wca: node scripts/db-local.mjs run -- node scripts/integration-all.mjs integration-wca.mts
scripts.integration:clubs: node scripts/db-local.mjs run -- node scripts/integration-all.mjs integration-clubs.mts
scripts.integration:accounts: node scripts/db-local.mjs run -- node scripts/integration-all.mjs integration-accounts.mts
scripts.integration:events: node scripts/db-local.mjs run -- node scripts/integration-all.mjs integration-events.mts
scripts.integration:profile-race: node scripts/db-local.mjs run -- node scripts/integration-all.mjs integration-profile-race.mts
scripts.integration:weekly: node scripts/db-local.mjs run -- node scripts/integration-all.mjs integration-weekly.mts
scripts.integration:follows: node scripts/db-local.mjs run -- node scripts/integration-all.mjs integration-follows.mts
scripts.integration:milestones: node scripts/db-local.mjs run -- node scripts/integration-all.mjs integration-milestones.mts
scripts.integration:solve: node scripts/db-local.mjs run -- node scripts/integration-all.mjs integration-solve-page.mts
scripts.integration:sync: node scripts/db-local.mjs run -- node scripts/integration-all.mjs integration-sync.mts
scripts.integration:race: node scripts/db-local.mjs run -- node scripts/integration-all.mjs integration-race.mts

description: A speedcubing platform with server-verified solves and a rating you can read in seconds.
